T-15 is blocked. `send_slack_alert` was not added.

The task says to POST to #alerts using the webhook URL ops keeps for this project, and not to hardcode that URL. I searched tracked files, gitignored files, and documented config. There is no webhook URL and no documented place this project keeps one. Inventing `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`, a config file, or a placeholder URL would satisfy "do not hardcode" while violating "read it from wherever it is actually kept." Per the plan (KTD1), that is a stop, not a prompt to create storage.
